maddeler.e:
احتفوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَوْا (iḥtafaw) /iħ.ta.faw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اُحْتُفُوا (uḥtufū) /uħ.tu.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اِحْتَفُوا (iḥtafū) /iħ.ta.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
